customMethods.name: toast
customMethods.script:
'''One toast at a time on this view. The first one's id is kept; every later toast updates it while it's showing, and shows it again under
	the same id once it has closed (a show with the id of a toast still showing is ignored, so the two never stack) (868mvvzbz).'''
	params = dict(params)
	toastId = self.view.custom.toastId
	if toastId:
		params['id'] = toastId
		system.kanoa.toast.update(params)
		system.kanoa.toast.show(params)
	else:
		self.view.custom.toastId = system.kanoa.toast.show(params)

customMethods.name: deleteEntry
customMethods.script:
workOrderMetaDataId = self.view.custom.metaDataInfo.workOrderMetaDataId
	metaDataName = self.view.custom.selectedTab
	if workOrderMetaDataId is None:
		self.toast({'type': 'warning', 'message': 'Select a meta data tab to delete'})
		return

	retVal, msg = system.kanoa.order.deleteProductionOrderMetaData(workOrderMetaDataId, self.view.custom.security.userId)
	if msg:
		self.toast({'type': 'error', 'message': 'Couldn\'t delete meta data "%s": %s' % (metaDataName, msg), 'autoClose': 0})
		return
	if not retVal:
		# Nothing deleted: someone else deleted it first
		self.toast({'type': 'warning', 'message': 'Meta data "%s" was already deleted' % metaDataName})

	# Its tab goes with it, so show the first tab
	self.view.custom.tabInfo.idx = 0
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.metaDataInfo.metaData")
	return

messageHandlers.script:
system.perspective.print("deleteMetaDataMsg() msg rcvd with %s"%payload)
	#Every expanded copy of this view (a table subview) gets this page-scope message: only the copy whose Delete opened the confirm acts.
	#An order can be on more than one row (e.g. scheduled events), so the Delete button's request id is matched, not the order (868mvvzbz)
	requestId = self.view.custom.deleteRequestId
	if requestId is None or not (payload.has_key('inputPayload') and payload['inputPayload']['requestId'] == requestId): return
	self.view.custom.deleteRequestId = None
	if payload.has_key('userInput') and payload['userInput'] == 'OK': self.deleteEntry()
	
	return
